shortDescription.default: ECM Foundation - theme, ECM Hub Navigator and Metadata Explorer

longDescription.default: Module 1 of the ECM solution. Adds the ECM Hub Navigator (a security-trimmed hub and department mega menu driven by one SharePoint list) to every page, and a Metadata Explorer web part that groups documents by their metadata categories with links to each file. Uses only SharePoint REST and Search APIs; no Azure AD app registration is required.

features.title: ECM Foundation
features.description: Deploys the ECM Hub Navigator tenant-wide (scoped through the Tenant Wide Extensions list), the ECM Setup web part and the Metadata Explorer web part.
